scientific_integrity: The classification is derived analytically from the halving criterion and quadratic Chebotarev; finite exact checks do not establish its infinite assertion. No authorship or independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed rational elliptic curves with split monic cubics only; only divisibility by 8. Natural prime density is qualitative without an effective convergence rate. Earlier equivalent treatment via Galois four-torsion images may exist. No cryptographic application claimed.
title: Four exact prime-density classes for eight-divisible orders of split elliptic curves
